caption:
Lulu bounces on the trampoline with her kids every weekend, and lately her knees and ankles ache afterwards.

On a trampoline, the landing matters more than the height. Big jumps on straight knees can send more load into the joints, and bouncing together makes collisions and awkward landings more likely.

Hybi's tip: take turns one at a time, land with softly bent knees, keep bounces small and controlled, and rest every few minutes.
